chunks: From him, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Sa'id, from Hammad ibn 'Isa, from Muhammad ibn Maymun, who said:
Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام arrived performing tamattu' on the night of 'Arafah. He performed tawaf, exited ihram, went to some of his bondwomen, then entered into ihram for hajj and departed.

key_terms.أَحَلَّ: he exited the state of ihram
key_terms.أَهَلَّ بِالْحَجِّ: he entered into ihram for hajj
key_terms.فَطَافَ: he performed tawaf around the Ka'bah
key_terms.لَيْلَةَ عَرَفَةَ: the night before the standing at 'Arafah

ai.seo_question: Can a person still complete Hajj al-Tamattu' if they arrive on the night of 'Arafah?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام arrived on the night of 'Arafah while performing Hajj al-Tamattu'. He performed tawaf, came out of ihram, approached some of his bondwomen, and then re-entered ihram for hajj, indicating the continued validity of tamattu' at that time.
